summary: Frontend-only retest of iteration-41 HIGH bug (Ctrl+S in stacked Naya Party Khata window) plus F5/F6 overlay guard and quick regressions. All items PASS. (1) /rokad -> Nayi Entry -> new party name + Enter -> modal-party opens; Ctrl+S with focus in input-party-name -> only POST /api/parties fired, toast 'Khata ... ban gaya', modal-party closed, Rokad modal stayed open with amount kept and the new party selected; no POST /api/rokad. Repeated with focus blurred (activeElement=BODY) -> same result (highest z-index overlay z-[60] form submitted). Without a group selected, Ctrl+S shows the party form's 'Group chunna zaroori hai' validation toast (correct target). (2) Ctrl+S inside Rokad form alone -> exactly one POST /api/rokad, modal closed, row added. (3) F5/F6 on /rokad: Voucher Slip open -> F5/F6 no-op; Transfer modal open -> F5 no-op; Create-Party window open -> F5/F6 no-op (party name and rokad type unchanged); Rokad modal only -> F5 switches to Kharch, F6 to Jama, amount/desc kept; Dashboard F5 -> /rokad with Payment, F6 -> Receipt. (4) /journal Ctrl+S -> exactly one POST /api/journal, 'Journal saved'; Esc closes modals (stacked: first Esc closes party window only, second closes Rokad); '?' help lists F5/F6 Payment/Receipt voucher.
critical_code_review_comments: useGlobalSave/voucherOpen rely on the '.fixed.inset-0' class pair to detect overlays; any future modal built with a different class (e.g. shadcn Dialog portal) would be missed by both guards. Consider a shared data-overlay attribute.
Overlay z-index sort ties (several z-50 overlays) fall back to DOM order; fine today since only KhataModal is z-[60].
